description.value:
You have long, sharp, curved talons on your hands and feet. These can be used as a natural weapon that deals 1d6 slashing damage.
Each time you succeed on a contested Grapple check against a creature using your talon hands or talon feet, you may additionally deal the damage of your talon natural weapon to the creature as piercing damage.

system.chatFlavor: On a successful grapple check, you can deal your talon damage as piercing damage.
